_note: Figure 'water' (section 1). Every value carries its source, a verbatim quote and what it means (V3 truth rule, 22 November 2026).

lifetime_us.where: Section II, the distance-7 lifetime paragraph
lifetime_us.quote: constituent physical qubits (median 85±7 µs, best 119±13 µs)
lifetime_us.meaning: Effective lifetime 1/Γ averaged over states, the median over the qubits of the distance-7 grid. Not T1 (the chip's mean T1 is 68 µs).
lifetime_us.say: 85 µs is the median lifetime, averaged over every state a qubit can hold, of the qubits in Google's largest grid in 2024

stages.say: less than a thousandth of a blink

blink_s.meaning: A blink taken as a tenth of a second, as in 'How this was made'.

not_drawn.meaning: For defence only, never on the page: 37% and 14% are exp(-t/85 µs), the median qubit of the distance-7 grid; the paper's Eq. 8 with the chip means (T1 68 µs, T2 89 µs, 1/Γ about 81 µs) gives about 35% above a coin toss at 85 µs and 13% at 170 µs.

ink_left.meaning: What the drawn stages aim at, not measured from the drawing: exp(-t/85 µs) for the median qubit, 37% at 85 µs and 14% at 170 µs (with the chip means in the paper's Eq. 8, 35% and 13%). The forge was asked for 'about a third left' and 'a faint ghost'. Never printed.
